articles.title: Putin’s arsenal haunts Ukraine? 700 missiles in stock, 200+ new every month: Can Kyiv defend itself?
articles.description: Russia’s growing missile arsenal is raising fresh concerns for Ukraine as the war continues to strain Kyiv’s air defences. Reports suggest Moscow may have around 700 missiles in reserve while producing more than 200 additional missiles every month. If these estimates are accurate, Russia could sustain repeated waves of strikes against Ukrainian cities, military facilities and critical infrastructure. The figures also raise questions about Ukraine’s ability to intercept incoming attacks as it faces pressure on its supplies of air-defence systems and interceptor missiles. How long can Kyiv keep defending its skies against Putin’s expanding missile capacity?

articles.title: Delhi Chokes As AQI Crosses 400; BJP-AAP Clash As Capital Battles Severe Pollution
articles.description: Delhi's air quality has deteriorated sharply, with the AQI crossing 370 on Wednesday morning and several areas recording readings above 400 in the severe category. Dhaula Kuan, Ghazipur and Sunehri Bagh were among the worst-affected locations, while Noida and Gurugram continued to battle poor air quality. As the national capital struggles to breathe, a political blame game has erupted between Delhi and Punjab. Delhi Environment Minister Majinder Singh Sirsa blamed the Bhagwant Mann government, while the Punjab Chief Minister hit back. BJP and AAP leaders have also sparred over pollution levels and the role of stubble burning, with Diwali approaching and concerns growing over a further deterioration in air quality.
